question: During the first 16 minutes of the session (09:30:00-09:45:59 ET), the arm's spread gate judges each name on the SIP spread from 16 minutes earlier (our plan's delay), i.e. on premarket quotes. If the gate instead saw the ACTUAL SIP spread at the moment of the check (same 0.15% cap, unknown still refuses), would the desk's trades be at least as good per trade and would sessions make more money? This is the UPPER BOUND for any live real-time spread source; it does not choose one.
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-28 ~10:15 ET in chat, on 'spread_wide 151 (6) / tape_only 83 (4)': 'can we resolve these blockers at all?' then, to the offer to preregister a replay test of the actual SIP spread for the first 16 minutes as an upper bound: 'Yes, prereg it'.
registered_at: 2026-10-28 ~10:20 ET, before any variant of this study is built, run or read.
origin: 10/28 09:30-10:07: 121 of 182 arm 'spread_wide' and 67 of 77 'spread_unknown' refusals fell before 09:46; on 10/27 the desk made no buy before 09:46 (first ARM_OK after it). The admission gate already skips its spread check before open + delay + 1 minutes (ai_movers_sip_delay_min, 15) for this reason; the arm gate (should_arm_buy, sip_spread_pct with delay_min 16) does not. Spot check 10/28 (28 early refusals, one per name per 3 min, actual SIP spread pulled afterwards): 11 of 28 had an actual spread <= 0.15% (BMNR, MGM, SMCI at 0.05-0.11%); AXGN, TEX, OSW, AXTI were really wide (0.2-0.9%). Median delayed reading 0.45%, median actual 0.22%. That spot check is 10/28, which is NOT a stage-1 session.
prior: Mixed. For: the gate demonstrably misreads liquid names for 16 minutes, and the operator's top priority is entering Leg 1 early. Against: open-minute spreads are genuinely wider (the cost is charged in full here), earlier studies found the open/first minutes fade, and wide-spread squares lost heavily when admitted (spread gate study 10/1). Prior lift 0 +- 4 bp per trade.

knobs.ai_watch_open_spread_realtime_min: NEW, default 0 (off = live unchanged). REPLAY-ONLY: when > 0, an arm check within that many minutes after 09:30 ET reads the spread gate's input with delay_min 0 (the actual SIP spread at the check, fetched from historical SIP after the fact). Live it would request SIP the plan does not serve in real time; the runner refuses to start if the knob is non-zero in config/bot_config.json. tools/replay_session.py's sip_spread wrapper honours delay_min: a delay-0 read bypasses the recorded (delayed) value and is cached under its own key. Cap, the unknown-refuses rule and every check after the window are unchanged.
knobs.ai_watch_open_spread_rand_release_share: NEW, default 0 / ''. Control: within the same window, an arm check refused 'spread_wide' or 'spread_unknown' on the DELAYED reading is released (treated as passing the spread gate) when sha256(salt|symbol|day|floor(ts/30)) < share. Released checks are counted outside the paint (os_counts.released_rand); the variant's releases (delayed refused, actual passed) are counted as os_counts.released_variant.

variants.REF: The current live desk, pinned exactly as stale_age_replay's REF (as amended_slope_off: slope-now OFF), arm age at its live value, ai_watch_open_spread_realtime_min 0.
variants.RAND_k (k=1,2,3): REF + random release in the window, salt 'OS-k', share calibrated per session by count so the seed-averaged released checks are within +-10% of OPEN16's released checks (bisection, <= 4 passes per seed set, seeds run in parallel). A session that cannot be matched has no lift_rand (counted).
variants.REF_DUP: REF run twice on the first, middle and last session (determinism).
variants.SKIP16 (information): REF with the arm spread gate off inside the window (what the gate saves when it can see nothing better).

fidelity_gate: Uses stale_age_replay's 10/27 fidelity result for the REF desk (that study's gate, same pins); if it has not passed, this study does not run. Own check, required: on 2026-10-27, for 20 OPEN16 early-window checks sampled at random (seeded), the replay's delay-0 spread equals a direct sip_spread_pct(sym, now=ts, delay_min=0) within 0.01 points, and REF's early-window spread values equal the recorded live values. Fail = NOT TESTABLE.
harness: late_gates/stale_age harness (tools/replay_session.py, --engine recorded --exits live, --arm-age-from-prints as stale_age, paint on, one pinned --sha containing both knobs). Outputs ~/replay_runs/open_spread/DAY-VAR.json. Pricing as stale_age_read: entry at the first SIP trade within 60 s of the replayed decision; the FULL SIP quoted spread at that entry (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp, the actual NBBO at the entry, so early entries pay the open's spread); open_at_end marked at the SIP 15:49 close; failed fetch = session not scored; > 10% no-print = excluded.
screen_first: Stage 1 = the 22 recorded sessions 2026-09-28..2026-10-27 split by count in date order, EARLY (first 11) and LATE (last 11); the pass rule below is applied with those halves. SCREEN FAIL / UNDERPOWERED / CONTROL UNMATCHED stops the study; nothing is switched on and no forward sessions are spent. SCREEN PASS runs stage 2: >= 10 forward sessions from 2026-10-29, scored with the same rule over the forward sessions as one block (halves by count), with stage2_monitoring below. Declared: the movers full-market scan was dead 10/20-10/28 (fixed 09:59 10/28), so LATE's name population is narrower than the desk's design; it affects REF and every variant equally.
statistic: Per session: lift_ref = mean net(OPEN16) - mean net(REF), bp per trade; session_lift = sum net(OPEN16) - sum net(REF), bp per session at equal size; early_share = share of trades entered before 09:46; lift_rand = mean net(OPEN16) - mean over seeds of mean net(RAND_k). Sessions equal-weighted, day-clustered (std_scorer.day_stat), one-sided bounds at 0.975, t at n-1 df.
pass: OPEN16 PASSES the screen only if ALL hold: (1) in BOTH halves, lift_ref's lower bound >= -2 bp and its point estimate >= 0 (the operator's '2 bp + average >= 0', square_relax margin; REF_DUP difference > 1 bp raises the 2 bp by that amount); (2) session_lift > 0 over all scored sessions; (3) OPEN16's early_share exceeds REF's (it actually trades the window); (4) lift_rand >= 0; (5) the OPEN16 trades entered before 09:46 that have no REF match within 600 s (the ADDED trades) have mean net >= -5 bp; (6) >= 120 REF and >= 120 OPEN16 trades per half and >= 30 added trades in all.
power: MDE per half = 3.08 x max(sd_session(RAND avg - REF), sd_session(MDE1 - REF)) / sqrt(sessions); <= 6 bp per half, else UNDERPOWERED (stage 1 stops; the operator may extend to forward sessions). Declared likely thin: the window is 16 minutes and the desk opened 0 trades in it on 10/27.
fail: Either half's point estimate < 0, or any pass condition missed with power met: FAIL. The window stays closed (live unchanged) and the finding is recorded: 'seeing the open's real spread does not buy profitable early entries'.
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3 on the result. Then a separate decision (operator) on the LIVE source, each needing its own check before going live: (a) the free live IEX quote spread, calibrated against SIP on recorded days (IEX overstated 1.5-3.3x in earlier checks), or (b) paid real-time SIP under the no-spend-until-proven rule. This study's pass is the evidence that the window is worth paying for; it does not switch anything on.
stage2_monitoring: As square_relax stage2_monitoring: after each forward session, STOP if OPEN16's early_share is not above REF's, or OPEN16 trades < 70% of REF's, or that session's lift_ref < -10 bp; from the 3rd forward session STOP if the cumulative lift_ref's upper one-sided bound < 0. One-sided; no early PASS.
information_only: SKIP16 vs REF and vs OPEN16.
Released checks per session (variant vs controls); spread at release (actual vs delayed).
Added trades: count, mean net, win rate, mean entry-spread cost, by minute bucket (09:30-35, 35-40, 40-46).
Per-name: liquid names (actual spread <= 0.10%) vs the rest.
no_retuning: No other window length, cap or delay is scored as primary.
script: Knobs, the replay wrapper change, tools/studies/open_spread_run.py (reusing stale_age_run / late_gates_run, parallel control seeds) and tools/studies/open_spread_read.py (reusing stale_age_read pricing and square_relax_read's screen/stage-2 checks) are written after a result-skeptic READY; they may not change anything above. Runs after square_relax in the after-hours queue (one batch at a time).

amended.when: 2026-10-28 ~10:30 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (9 findings), before any code or replay.
amended.1_no_lookahead: A delay-0 read uses SIP quotes with timestamp <= the check ts only (the minute ending at ts). Its cache key is sym|day|int(ts) (or it is computed at read time from one stored per-name quote pull); never the shared sym|int(t//180) JsonCache bucket. Test: a fetch made for t+100 never serves a check at t.
amended.2_no_leak: Delay-0 reads call sip_spread_pct with record=False, use their own cache, and never write _SIP_SPREAD_CACHE, so the push filter (_slot_unseatable), the Gates column and the recorded inputs see only the delayed value.
amended.3_scope: Renamed: 'upper bound GIVEN live's engine population'. Declared: names the push filter kept off the engine (wide delayed spread, CRWV 10/28) have no recorded tape in either arm, so OPEN16 cannot trade them. Reported per session: released names with no recorded tape in the window.
amended.4_fidelity: Replaces the REF half of fidelity_gate. On 2026-10-27, REF's 09:30-09:46 arm refusals by code (spread_wide, spread_unknown) and its buys in the window, against the live decision ledger, each within 50-200% (stale_age's rule; 0 live buys = replay must also have 0); plus the share of window spread reads served from the recording vs fetched inline, printed. Fail = NOT TESTABLE. The OPEN16 equality check (20 sampled delay-0 reads vs a direct sip_spread_pct at delay 0 within 0.01 points, quotes <= ts) stays.
amended.5_two_sided_control: OPEN16 can also BLOCK (actual open spread wider than the premarket reading). Counted: os_counts.released_variant and os_counts.blocked_variant. RAND_k both releases (delayed-refused checks) and blocks (REF-passing window checks) at random, each matched by count to OPEN16 (+-10%, bisection on two shares). Reported separately: released-only and blocked-only effects (variants OPEN16_REL = release only, OPEN16_BLK = block only, information). Condition (3) stays.
amended.6_primary: Replaces pass (1), (2) and (5). PRIMARY: added-trade net = mean net of OPEN16 trades entered 09:30-09:46 with no REF match within 600 s, minus the same for RAND (seed-averaged), per session, day-clustered: point estimate >= 0 in BOTH halves AND lower one-sided bound (0.975) >= -5 bp over all scored sessions. session_lift (sum net OPEN16 - REF, bp per session at equal size) point estimate >= 0 in BOTH halves. HARM CHECK: whole-session per-trade lift_ref lower bound >= -2 bp (+ REF_DUP penalty) in both halves. Conditions (3), (4) as before; (6) becomes >= 30 added trades in all and >= 120 REF trades per half.
amended.7_power: MDE is computed on the added-trade statistic (3.08 x sd_session(added-trade net difference, RAND vs OPEN16 placebo seeds) / sqrt(sessions)), <= 10 bp per half. BEFORE any means are scored: OPEN16 count-only on the first, middle and last stage-1 session; if the projected added-trade count over the 22 sessions is < 30, the study is UNDERPOWERED and stops (no means read).
amended.8_rand_persistence: Reported per arm: added trades. RAND's seed-averaged added trades must be within +-25% of OPEN16's over the stage-1 sessions, else CONTROL UNMATCHED (UNPROVEN).
amended.9_small: (a) entry_spread_bp None drops are counted per arm inside the window; > 10% of window trades in any arm = that session excluded (counted). (b) Declared: the push-filter fix 1fc09d5d ships after the 10/28 close, so stage-2 (forward) REF differs from stage-1 REF; stage 2 is scored against its own REF only. (c) The knob covers the ARM spread gate in should_arm_buy only; the Leg-1 gate (off in this REF) and admission (already skips the window) are unchanged.
amended.pass_update: In 'pass', conditions (1), (2), (5) are replaced by 6_primary; (3), (4), (6 as amended) remain. 'statistic' gains added-trade net and the two-sided control.

amended_2.when: 2026-10-28 ~10:45 ET, result-skeptic round 2 (FIX FIRST, text only), fix text applied verbatim, before any code or replay.
amended_2.2_no_leak: Delay-0 reads do not call sip_spread_pct directly. They use a separate pure function (same median over the minute ending at ts, quotes <= ts) or a wrapper that saves and restores _SIP_SPREAD_CACHE[sym]. Test: after a delay-0 read, _SIP_SPREAD_CACHE is unchanged.
amended_2.4_fidelity: If 4_fidelity fails, the study is NOT TESTABLE on this harness. Switching to bind_gate_values would be a new amendment reviewed before any run, not a rerun.
amended_2.5_two_sided_control: The release share and the block share are bisected independently in the same passes. Each must land within +-10% of OPEN16's count, otherwise CONTROL UNMATCHED. No other target may be calibrated after a miss.
amended_2.6_primary: Sessions where OPEN16 or RAND (seed-averaged) has 0 added trades are left out of the primary and counted. The primary needs >= 6 sessions with added trades in EACH half, else UNDERPOWERED. t uses n-1 df on those sessions.
amended_2.7_power: sd_session = sd across sessions of (RAND_1 added net - mean(RAND_2, RAND_3) added net) x sqrt(3/2). Count-only runs also produce RAND's matched added counts. If the projected RAND or OPEN16 added count is < 30, stop.
amended_2.9_small: A session is excluded for every arm when >= 2 window trades in any arm lack an entry spread.
amended_2.verdict_wording: Report FAIL (point < 0) separately from FAIL (bound only); the second is recorded as 'not shown', not 'refuted'.
